name: document
purpose: Maintain the canonical source-grounded knowledge or handoff without fabricating OpenWiki guarantees.

criteria.description: Ground knowledge in current code, tests, history or supplied evidence.
Update the canonical reader-oriented owner with progressive links.
Check actual links/commands and do not invent unobserved OpenWiki state guarantees.

limits: Mechanical verification checks recorded facts and actual retained bytes; a recorded semantic inspection is not authenticated judgment.
Compilation and fixture success do not prove complete semantic workflow performance or provider/native-host activation.
The deterministic core checks documentation evidence/coverage. Knowledge composition and actual OpenWiki lifecycle guarantees require their real procedures/adapters.
